description_fr: Brown-Forman Corporation est un groupe americain de spiritueux base a Louisville (Kentucky), cote au NYSE sous les tickers BFA et BFB. Son portefeuille s'articule autour du whiskey (la famille de marques Jack Daniel's, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester), de la tequila (Herradura, el Jimador), des boissons pretes a boire (Ready-to-Drink, avec New Mix et Jack Daniel's RTD) et d'un reste de portefeuille incluant le gin (Gin Mare) et le rhum (Diplomatico). Le groupe commercialise ses marques aux Etats-Unis, dans les marches internationaux developpes, les marches emergents et le canal Travel Retail. Brown-Forman verse un dividende trimestriel regulier depuis plus de 80 ans et figure dans l'indice S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats.
description_en: Brown-Forman Corporation is an American spirits company headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky, listed on the NYSE under tickers BFA and BFB. Its portfolio centers on whiskey (the Jack Daniel's family of brands, Woodford Reserve, Old Forester), tequila (Herradura, el Jimador), Ready-to-Drink beverages (New Mix and Jack Daniel's RTD) and a Rest of Portfolio including gin (Gin Mare) and rum (Diplomatico). The company sells its brands in the United States, Developed International markets, Emerging markets and the Travel Retail channel. Brown-Forman has paid a regular quarterly dividend for more than 80 years and is a member of the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats Index.
